155.news_title: Ultra High Definition 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitors
155.long_description: Introducing Arcooda’s ultra high definition LCD monitor series that offer 2880x2160 resolution in 4:3 aspect ratio. Perfectly suited for professionals in digital art, signage display, arcade machine operators and retro gamers. Our new release 4:3 aspect ratio ultra high definition monitors offer numerous features including; PC Video Signals Supported - 640x480 (VGA) - 800x600 (SVGA) - 960x720 (Small HD camera setting) - 1024x768 (XGA) - 1152x864 (XGA+) - 1280x960 - 1400x1050 (SXGA+) - 1440x1080 (Common for digitized video) - 1600x1200 (UXGA) - 2048x1536 (QXGA) - 2880x2160 RGB Video Signals Supports - 15khz, 24hhz, 25khz, 31khz including sync on green, combined sync and separate sync Other features include; • RGB/VGA, DVI, HDMI and Display port inputs • Auto picture function for arcade machines, slot machines, or industrial RGB machinery • Full viewing angle for digital display, arcade gaming • Low display lag • Breakout OSD board to control monitor from any location • Audio output • Remote control • Multiple mounting options including machine mounting, wall and desktop mounting via VESA. Our UHD monitors offer the perfect solution for arcade machine operators, retro gamers, digital displays, embedded systems, and those working with media or compositions in a 4:3 canvas. The new models just released are 26inch & 35inch in 4:3 aspect ratio up to 2880x2160 resolution; https://www.arcooda.com/buy/26-inch-Arcooda-4-3-Ratio-Arcade-LCD-Monitor-15khz-24khz-31khz-up-to-2880x2160-4K--20217 https://www.arcooda.com/buy/35-inch-Arcooda-4-3-Ratio-Arcade-LCD-Monitor-15khz-24khz-31khz-up-to-2880x2160-20214
